key.description: A short kebab-case name unique within this response. Other tasks refer to it in depends_on.

goal.description: One self-contained change, phrased as an instruction. Not a theme or an area of the codebase.

constraints.description: Rules the implementation must follow, drawn from how this repository already works.

verify.description: The command that proves this task is done, e.g. go test ./... — null if the repository has no usable one.

blocking_severity.description: The lowest review severity that should hold this task's loop open.

cost_cap.description: An advisory spend ceiling in USD for this task, or null for the daemon default.

depends_on.description: Keys of tasks that must finish first. Only tasks earlier in this array may be named.

rationale.description: Why this is worth doing, in one sentence, referring to what you actually read.
